# 2,720.00 USD arriving in a US dollar bank, in a transaction stated in US
# dollars, with its other split on the director's account for 3,791.14 CAD
# because nobody yet knew what the money was for; and a 0.72 USD bank fee drawn
# on the cost basis the arrival opened.
#
# The transaction is stated in US dollars, so what the dollars cost is worked
# out from its Canadian dollar split: 3,791.14 CAD over 2,720.00 USD. That split
# sets the rate; its account does not.
#
# - ..._moved_to_income.txt moves the Canadian dollar split to income with
#   `--strategy update`, every figure the same;
# - ..._amount_changed.txt restates its amount, which re-prices the cost basis.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_an_edit_may_move_the_split_that_sets_the_rate.py.
